name: vaadin-agent-tools
description: Vaadin tools for AI agents: inspect and validate Vaadin projects with a self-contained native CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and validate Vaadin projects from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Vaadin Agent Tools bundles a native CLI and Codex skills for creating Vaadin projects, checking theme configuration issues such as Aura/Lumo mixing, and validating how a project's CSS uses the Aura theme's custom properties. It runs from committed binaries with no Node.js or JVM runtime requirement.
defaultPrompt: Check this Vaadin project for theme mixing.
Check this project's CSS for Aura theme misuse.
Create a new Vaadin project in ./my-app.
